nodes.name: RuleNotFoundError.ts
nodes.summary: Domain error raised when a rule id does not resolve, mapped to a not_found StandardsError with rule_not_found reason.

nodes.name: RuleNotFoundError
nodes.summary: Thrown when a rule id is unknown; not_found kind with rule id context.

nodes.name: RuleNotInSpaceError.ts
nodes.summary: Domain error raised when a rule exists but does not belong to the requested space, hiding cross-space existence behind a not_found answer.

nodes.name: RuleNotInSpaceError
nodes.summary: Thrown when a rule is outside the requested space; reports not_found to avoid leaking existence.

nodes.name: StandardNotFoundError.ts
nodes.summary: Domain error raised when a standard id cannot be found, carrying the standard id in its typed context.

nodes.name: StandardNotFoundError
nodes.summary: Thrown when a standard id is unknown; not_found kind with standard id context.

nodes.name: StandardSlugNotFoundError.ts
nodes.summary: Domain error for an unknown standard slug or a slug living in another space, deliberately indistinguishable so callers (often MCP agents) cannot probe other spaces.

nodes.name: StandardSlugNotFoundError
nodes.summary: Thrown for an unknown or out-of-space standard slug, keeping slug and space in context.

nodes.name: StandardSpaceNotAccessibleError.ts
nodes.summary: Domain error raised when the caller cannot access the space a standard lives in.

nodes.name: StandardSpaceNotAccessibleError
nodes.summary: Thrown when the caller lacks access to the space of a standard.

nodes.name: StandardSpaceRequiredError.ts
nodes.summary: Domain error raised when a standards operation is invoked without the mandatory space id.

nodes.name: StandardSpaceRequiredError
nodes.summary: Thrown when a space id is required but missing.

nodes.name: StandardVersionMissingError.ts
nodes.summary: Internal invariant error raised when an existing standard has lost its version record.

nodes.name: StandardVersionMissingError
nodes.summary: Internal error for a standard whose version record is missing.

nodes.name: StandardsAdapterPortsMissingError.ts
nodes.summary: Internal invariant error raised when the StandardsAdapter is used before its required ports are wired.

nodes.name: StandardsAdapterPortsMissingError
nodes.summary: Internal error listing missing adapter ports in its context.

nodes.name: StandardsError.ts
nodes.summary: Base class for user-facing standards domain errors, carrying a DomainErrorKind (driving the HTTP status), a literal reason union and a typed id context.

nodes.name: StandardsError
nodes.summary: Base domain error with kind, reason and typed context, implementing DomainError.

nodes.name: StandardsHexaDependencyMissingError.ts
nodes.summary: Internal invariant error raised when StandardsHexa cannot resolve a required hexa dependency during initialization.

nodes.name: StandardsHexaDependencyMissingError
nodes.summary: Internal error naming the hexa dependency that could not be resolved.

nodes.name: StandardsInternalError.ts
nodes.summary: Base class for standards broken-invariant errors on top of PackmindInternalError: always 500, logged with stack, message withheld from clients.

nodes.name: StandardsInternalError
nodes.summary: Base internal error extending PackmindInternalError with standards-specific reasons.
